headline: Committee recommends Resolution 26-132, discusses special counsel spending limit

meeting.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meeting.summary: The committee voted 7 to 0 to recommend adopting Resolution 26-132. Members also took up Resolution 26-131, which would raise the limit for special counsel by $250,000, to $450,000 total.
meeting.recap: Resolution 26-131 would raise the limit for special counsel by $250,000, to $450,000 total.[[0:05:01]] The special counsel represents Captain Scott Martin in a lawsuit filed by Chelsea Evans.[[0:06:40]] A deputy corporation counsel said state law requires defending firefighters sued for acts done on duty.[[0:25:28]] The deal adds a 1.5% raise on top of a 2.5% arbitration award, for 4% total, starting July 1, 2027.[[0:36:28]] A deputy corporation counsel said the court dismissed all of Mr. Salem's claims against the county.[[1:03:26]] One testifier opposed more legal fees, saying a developer was responsible for unfinished permit requirements.[[1:07:48]] A deputy corporation counsel said billings received in July exceeded the funds available.[[1:26:28]] The committee voted 7 to 0 to recommend adopting Resolution 26-132.[[1:32:15]]
meeting.next: The Personnel Services representative said the employer group is discussing strategies for the next round of negotiations.

moments.q: Fire union testifier: "recruitment is at an all-time low"
"the firefighter shall be represented and defended."
Mr. Salem: "Or we fight for years. It's your choice."
